name: Manggung Polahraya Tbk.
summary: PT Manggung Polahraya Tbk is an Indonesian company primarily engaged in the construction sector. Its operations encompass general building construction as well as the development of road infrastructure projects. Beyond its contracting services, the firm also manufactures and supplies essential construction materials, specifically hot mix asphalt and ready mix concrete. Established in 1992, the company maintains its main office in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
